facts.value: Reads the B-button bit from fp->input.pressed_buttons and horizontal/vertical values from fp->input.lstick[0], comparing their absolute magnitudes against p_ftCommonData->x218 and x21C. Returns a Boolean without writes. The fighter input-age update resets x689 to zero for true or increments it toward 0xFF for false; ftCo_800D6824 dispatches ftData_SpecialN[fp->kind] when that callback is nonnull and x689 is zero.
facts.rationale: Replace obsolete x668 and scalar lstick field spellings with the pinned canonical pressed_buttons and lstick[0] accesses; include callback-null guard.

evidence.why: Pressed B plus two strict absolute-axis comparisons, no mutation.
True resets x689; false saturates age at 255.
Zero input age dispatches nonnull kind-specific SpecialN callback.

facts.value: Returns true exactly when pressed_buttons contains HSD_PAD_B and ABS(lstick[0].x) < x218 and ABS(lstick[0].y) < x21C. Equality with either threshold fails. No action state or input field is changed here. The caller resets x689 on true and otherwise increments it only below 0xFF.

facts.value: Small-data literal storage containing one four-byte single-precision zero, source-object symbol @100 at offset zero. The source-built object section has raw size4 and ELF flags3 (WRITE|ALLOC). The split reference section has size8 and flags2 (ALLOC), with the zero literal plus a four-byte gap. The frozen report attributes8 bytes; these object variants do not establish identical section flags or two semantic constants.
facts.rationale: Distinguish source-built and split-reference ELF metadata: source flags3 are writable, reference flags2 are nonwritable. Both corroborate the zero literal, with the reference gap separately accounted.

facts.value: Defines a read-only neutral-special input predicate over a Fighter pointer. It tests a pressed B bit and requires both left-stick axes to lie strictly within configured absolute thresholds; callers separately age the recognized input and enter a kind-specific neutral special.
facts.rationale: Complete source and bounded callers establish unit role without assigning move entry to this predicate.
